scientific_integrity: An exact rational Bernstein/Taylor certificate establishes the only nontrivial global monotonicity inequality. Six deterministic quadratures are corroborative, not a substitute for analysis. No claim of external verification or certified historical novelty.
scientific_limitations: Geodesically convex spherical lunes of opening angle at most pi, independent normalized surface-area points, ambient Euclidean chords, exact population second and fourth chord moments. A complete scalar inverse and optimal angular exponent are established; noise robustness for radius and nonconvex lunes are not. The historical literature comparison is not an independent priority certification.
title: Two even chord moments identify spherical lunes, with sharp square-root angle stability
